subject: Penetration test report access request — controlled on-screen review & remediation plan
messages:
From: Jill Turner <jill.turner@acme-corp.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Andy Connors <andy.connors@acme-corp.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for full penetration test report and scope confirmation

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Acme's vendor risk team is closing out the technical review and they asked for the most recent penetration test report (scope and findings) that covers the Redwood production inference stack we will rely on. Specifically they want:

- Full assessment report from the 2026 engagement (all findings, PoCs, remediation evidence)
- Confirmation of scope (which clusters/regions and components were in scope) and test dates
- A remediation plan and expected closure dates for critical/high issues

Can you send the report directly, or point us to the right process to receive it? If sharing the full document is restricted, please advise alternate steps (NDA, redacted report, on-site/on-screen review) and the timeline.

We'd like to wrap vendor review by May 17 to meet our procurement window.

Appreciate it — Jill
Jill Turner
Senior InfoSec Manager, Acme Corp
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jill Turner <jill.turner@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Andy Connors <andy.connors@acme-corp.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 11:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for full penetration test report and scope confirmation

Hi Jill — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Monica (Security) and Laura (Legal) to scope the right response. Short answer: we do not publish raw penetration-test reports externally because they contain sensitive exploit details and PoCs that could increase risk if broadly distributed. However, we can support Acme via the following options: 

1) Executive summary (PDF) and a remediation matrix with status for each finding (attached). This covers all critical/high items with mitigation timelines and evidence where appropriate.
2) Controlled on-screen review: we can schedule a secure, shared screen session where Monica or a senior engineer reviews the full report on-screen with your team for vetted attendees only. During that session we can walk PoCs but will not provide downloadable copies.
3) Redacted report by agreement: Legal will review and approve the redactions; this takes longer and requires a mutual NDA and a limited distribution list.

Monica — can you confirm current remediation status for the critical/high findings and estimate closure windows? Laura — please confirm what we need from Acme to proceed with a redaction or on-screen review (NDA template, attendee list).

Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Jill Turner <jill.turner@acme-corp.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Andy Connors <andy.connors@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for full penetration test report and scope confirmation

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the options. A few clarifying Qs from procurement & risk:

- Procurement policy requires evidence of remediation for any Critical findings within 30 days and High within 90 days. Is Redwood able to commit a remediation schedule that meets that?
- Our risk team specifically asks for PoC screenshots or logs proving fixes for Critical items. Would you provide those during the on-screen review, or will you redact them?
- If you insist on an on-screen-only approach, our compliance officer will need to see the full report (not just summary) during that session. Can you also confirm the pen-test vendor and dates so we can reconcile scope?

Ideal: on-screen review next week, plus an exec summary for procurement now.

— Jill
From: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jill Turner <jill.turner@acme-corp.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for full penetration test report and scope confirmation — remediation status and options

Hi Jill — Monica from Redwood Security here. Quick answers and a remediation snapshot below.

Pen-test vendor & scope: RedTeam (pen@redteam.io). Engagement dates: 2026-04-15 to 2026-04-20. Scope: production inference control plane (us-west-2), model-serving nodes, API gateway, auth flows; excluded: customer-managed private deployments and offline dev environments.

Policy on full reports: due to the inclusion of exploit payloads and PoC code we do not distribute raw reports publicly. Per Karthik we can offer a secure on-screen review for up to 6 named attendees or a mutually agreed redacted copy.

Remediation matrix (summary):
- FIND-2026-CRIT-01: Remote auth bypass via legacy token endpoint — status: fixed (hotfix deployed 2026-04-28), mitigation evidence: patch PR #4821, deployment runbook, live auth logs attached.
- FIND-2026-HIGH-02: Insufficient rate-limit on unauthenticated endpoint — status: in progress, mitigation planned 2026-05-12, rollback window 2026-05-14, temporary WAF rule applied 2026-04-30.
- FIND-2026-HIGH-03: KV cache exposure under specific header permutations — status: scheduled, mitigation 2026-05-18, test plan attached.

We can commit to Critical items closed within 30 days (already done for the single critical), and High items we are tracking with target closures inside 90 days; I'll provide a CSV with per-finding owner and evidence fields (attached: remediation_matrix_acme-20260503.csv).

For PoC evidence: during the on-screen review we will show PoC screenshots/logs and the remediation verification steps. We will not hand over raw exploit scripts or full raw report PDFs. If Acme needs redacted artifacts for procurement, Laura can initiate a redaction review once we have an attendee list and an executed mutual NDA.

Proposed next steps:
1) I will drop an executive summary to your Drive and attach the remediation matrix (done).
2) Tentative on-screen review: Wed May 12 or Mon May 17 (30–60 min). Please confirm preferred slot and attendees.
3) If you require a redacted copy, provide a shortlist of authorized reviewers and sign a mutual NDA.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: remediation_matrix_acme-20260503.csv, soc2-reference-notes.txt
